item.title: For International Visitors: Hi, We Are Koyo Gakuin HS Physics Club!
item.description: Welcome to our home page! We are Koyo Gakuin High School Physics Club and thank you for visiting our website. Koyo Gakuin is a private school with unified lower and upper secondary school programs, both of whose school buildings are located in Nishinomiya, Hyogo Prefecture.
